user.title: Backlog AI Hub
user.description: Address of the AI Hub's Backlog API (e.g. https://hub.example/backlog-api, or just the hub's address) and the Backlog token shown in the hub's console.

data_description.ca_cert: Path of the hub's CA certificate, e.g. /config/aihub-ca.crt, when the hub uses its own certificate authority.

reauth_confirm.title: Backlog AI Hub
reauth_confirm.description: The hub refused the token. Paste the current Backlog token.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the hub's Backlog service at this address (or its certificate is not trusted).

not_loaded.message: Backlog AI Hub is not set up (or the hub is unreachable).

invalid_auth.message: The hub refused the token: update it in the integration.

ajouter_tache.name: Add or update a task
ajouter_tache.description: Creates a task in the AI Hub Backlog, or completes an existing one.

id.name: ID
id.description: Identifier (e.g. t-low-battery). An existing ID completes that entry.

prio.name: Priority
prio.description: maintenant (now), semaine (this week), temps (when there is time), attente (waiting), idee (idea), fait (done).

type.name: Type
type.description: tester (test), reparer (fix), decider (decide), ranger (tidy), supprimer (remove), idee (idea).

action.name: Action
action.description: What has to be done, in one sentence.

dire.name: Short prompt
dire.description: A short sentence to say to an agent.

prompt.name: Long prompt
prompt.description: A complete prompt for an agent.

demande.name: Request
demande.description: The original request, shown on the card.

rapide.name: Quick win
rapide.description: Short task with nothing to wait for.

moment.name: Moment
moment.description: When to do it: {date, heure, note}.

items.name: Items
items.description: Checks: [{id, n, scenario?}]. Merged by ID unless « Replace items ».

remplacer_items.name: Replace items
remplacer_items.description: Replace the whole list of items instead of merging.

maquettes.name: Mockups
maquettes.description: List of items with option, image and optional legende.

captures.name: Screenshots
captures.description: List of items with image, optional titre and optional legende.

conditions.name: Conditions
conditions.description: Live conditions of a test (see the hub's documentation).

ajouter_journal.name: Add a journal entry
ajouter_journal.description: Writes an entry in the Backlog journal.

id.name: ID
id.description: Identifier (e.g. t-low-battery). An existing ID completes that entry.

date.name: Date
date.description: Defaults to today (the hub's time zone).

cocher.name: Check items
cocher.description: Checks (or unchecks) items or whole tasks.

repondre.name: Answer a « not conclusive »
repondre.description: Answers an item marked « not conclusive ».

verifie.name: Answer a 🔍 check
verifie.description: Gives the result of an item flagged « check it yourself ».

resultat.name: Result
resultat.description: confirme (confirmed, checks the item), attente (waiting), contredit (contradicted).

decision_traitee.name: Mark a decision as handled
decision_traitee.description: Writes the answer to a decision given in the Backlog.

cible.name: Target
cible.description: The question item, or the task when it has no question.

supprimer.name: Delete an entry
supprimer.description: Deletes one entry of a collection.

id.name: ID
id.description: Identifier (e.g. t-low-battery). An existing ID completes that entry.

exporter.name: Export
exporter.description: Returns the whole Backlog (use a response variable).
